Matches mobile Company Tasks rows squeezing task titles into very little readable space; relation-chip clipping is an additional reported effect.

Matches a pre-existing seeded attachment failing retrieval with HTTP 404. This path opens a Task image preview rather than attempting a Company attachment download.
